downtown.name: Downtown
downtown.subtitle: The commercial heart
downtown.description: Offices, politicians and the docks. High-value work; heavy police presence. No dominant organization.
downtown.alt: Downtown towers, rain-soaked commerce and docks under police watch

rio.name: Rio Gabriel
rio.subtitle: Eastside
rio.description: Lowriders and black-market trade. Gabriel’s Angels enjoy substantial community support.
rio.alt: Lowriders along warm Eastside streets in Rio Gabriel

south.name: Southside
south.subtitle: Old loyalty. New ambition.
south.description: Back Street is politically isolated. Younger members question Justice’s turn toward legitimate business.
south.alt: Southside project housing above worn neighborhood streets

resevoir.name: The Resevoir
resevoir.subtitle: Westside
resevoir.description: Boarded houses, vacant lots and deep neighborhood roots. Block Boys have strong local support and a violent rivalry with the Angels.
resevoir.alt: Boarded homes and vacant lots in The Resevoir at sunset

nawf.name: The Nawf
nawf.subtitle: Northside
nawf.description: The Blips’ purple and Mudgang’s brown share the zone. Residents want their long feud to end.
nawf.alt: The Nawf’s bodega, elevated train and defaced Mudgang memorial
